title: Momentum and its conservation; Impulse and force–time graphs; Rotational kinematics
source: Questions copied unchanged from the mission-lesson scripts for AP Physics 1 (status of the source: mission-lesson scripts of Oct-Nov 2026 (reviewed by AI reviewers; not signed off by a person)). Terms and clues: D09-ap2#t2 term and clue written for the game; D09-ap2#t3 term and clue written for the game; R01-1#t3 term and clue written for the game; R01-1#t4 term and clue written for the game. Questions: D09-ap2#N.10, D10-1#N.4b, R01-1#N.2, D10-1#N.12, R01-1#N.5b, R01-1#N.7.

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Component
items.clue: The x or y part into which a vector is split.

items.label: Elastic collision
items.clue: The only kind of impact in which kinetic energy is conserved.

items.label: Rigid system
items.clue: Body that keeps its shape, so every point shares the same ω and α.

items.label: Tangential acceleration
items.clue: Linear quantity equal to rα for a point at distance r from the axis.

questions.stem: An open cart of mass 3m rolls at speed v₀ along a level track with negligible friction. A ball of mass m falls vertically into the cart and stays in it; just before it lands, the ball's speed is 4v₀. What is the speed of the cart, with the ball in it, just after the ball lands?

Pucks A and B are at rest on level ice with negligible friction. Puck A has mass m, and puck B has mass 2m. Each puck is pushed by the same constant horizontal force F for the same time interval Δt. After the push, puck A has momentum of magnitude p_A. What is the magnitude of puck B's momentum after the push?
A disc on a fixed axle rotates 1.0 revolution counter-clockwise and then 0.25 revolution clockwise. Counter-clockwise is taken as positive. What is the disc's angular displacement?

Two identical 0.50 kg gliders on an air track each move at 2.0 m s⁻¹ towards an obstacle. Glider 1 hits a steel buffer and bounces straight back at 2.0 m s⁻¹; the contact lasts 0.010 s. Glider 2 hits a foam pad and stops; the contact lasts 0.040 s. How many times larger is the average force on glider 1 than the average force on glider 2?

options.text: 1, as both gliders arrive with the same speed

questions.stem: Two identical fans, X and Y, start from rest. Each speeds up with constant angular acceleration until it reaches the same final angular velocity. The angular acceleration of fan X is twice that of fan Y. What is the ratio Δθ_X/Δθ_Y of the angles through which the fans turn while speeding up?

A light string is wrapped around a pulley of radius 0.0600 m that turns on a fixed axle. The string is pulled so that it unwinds without slipping while the pulley turns through 20.0 rad. What length of string unwinds from the pulley?
